blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan’s Fifth Division has dismissed Sen. Jinggoy Estrada’s motion for reconsideration on his 90-day suspension for lack of merit. Estrada is detained for alleged plunder said to involve P573 million in kickbacks from government infrastructure projects. READ: Jinggoy Estrada suspended anew for plunder READ: Bernardo: Jinggoy Estrada asked my ‘help’ to get P1-B ‘leadership fund’ The Fifth Division said “the cases pending in this division are distinct and independent from that pending in the Second Division” where the senator said he had already served an earlier suspension. —Dianne Sampang...
